core_obligations: The author establishes universal divisibility for determinants of Hadamard products of bordered-minor compound matrices, including the one-zero-corner det(A) factor and the two-zero-corner det(A)det(B) factor in one family. The proof combines the original universal polynomial-ring argument, determinant irreducibility/localization and kernel/adjugate constructions, then specializes to arbitrary commutative rings. No invertibility/domain assumptions are added to the final theorem. Standard Sylvester identities and n/k examples remain context, not counts.
